body:
Hi Dudes its pvp teams first scrim ever so we are looking for a team to go against we are at like 13 players if Kuzzie And xMasterSlayer Join so we are going to scrim tomorrow hopefully. Any team leaders want to vs us that would be great and im quite stuck cuz I don't know how to get scrimmages but hopefully a staff member will help :) We are looking for a quite challenging team I kinda want a 2 hour scrim. I Want a 2 hour scrim cuz its our first scrim and we need some practice. Hopefully the pvp team and we get a scrim cuz everyone if leaving team because I haven't scrimmed yet so if you do wanna scrim tomorrow tell me below. If you do tell me below I will invite you to the team. Hoping to get to 20 players by Friday.


Hope you guys enjoyed the post and ill see you fellow pvpers soon in our scrim :)

P.S Hopefully a staff member will tell us which scrim server we are and what time it is bye guys :D
